blocks.orig: Giraffe Manor Tanzania is a one-of-a-kind lodge set on the serene Dolly Estate just outside Arusha, where mornings often come with giraffes walking by as you sip your first cup of coffee! Surrounded by lush lawns, flowering gardens, and acacia woodland with birdlife, impala, elands, zebra, and wildebeest, the lodge offers a peaceful setting while remaining close to Kilimanjaro International Airport and Arusha National Park – an ideal starting point for the northern safari circuit. And with views stretching toward Mount Meru, you can watch stunning sunsets from the upstairs deck, relax by the infinity pool with sunken lounges, or spend time in the elegant lounges and bar. The restaurant here serves fresh, locally sourced dishes, while the accommodation features comfortable rooms – some with private plunge pools and terraces – overlooking the manicured grounds. It’s an experience shaped by calm comfort, open space, and the possibility of unexpected wildlife encounters!
blocks.html: Giraffe Manor Tanzania is a unique lodge on the peaceful Dolly Estate just outside Arusha, where giraffes often stroll past in the morning while you drink your first cup of coffee! The lodge is surrounded by green lawns, flowering gardens and acacia woodland that is home to birds, impala, elands, zebra and wildebeest, so the setting is calm, yet Kilimanjaro International Airport and Arusha National Park are close by – a perfect place to begin the northern safari circuit. The views reach towards Mount Meru, so you can watch beautiful sunsets from the upstairs deck, unwind at the infinity pool with its sunken lounges, or spend time in the elegant lounges and the bar. Fresh dishes made with local ingredients are served in the restaurant, and the comfortable rooms – some with their own plunge pools and terraces – look out over the manicured grounds. Your stay is all about quiet comfort, wide open space and the chance of surprising wildlife encounters!
